name: EPIC 229045701

text.card: A red giant 5,232 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.53 solar masses and 10.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,828 K at its surface.
